name: Process, Workflow, Method and Procedure
constraints: WM-ACT-009 owns reusable authored method and procedure knowledge and immutable editions.
WM-ACT-003 owns released process definitions, variants, instances, work items and execution traces.
A process references the exact adopted method edition and never copies the knowledge artifact.
Publication or adoption of a method never constitutes execution.
Every process instance pins one immutable released definition and variant.
Variants are concurrent alternatives and versions supersede only within a variant lineage.
Work-item state and step-execution events remain distinct.
Planned flow never proves actual performance.
Deviation, manual exception, escalation and compensation are explicit append-only facts.
Method effect begins at adopter-specific effective adoption rather than publication.
Missing trace evidence never proves conformance.
Historical replay pins definition, variant, method edition and event order.
